why: Rules frozen before live trading so the live record is a clean test. Do not change them after seeing live trades; any change becomes v4 with a new date.

setups.name: Big unlock
setups.rule: the unlock adds 25% or more of circulating supply

setups.name: First insider unlock + falling open interest
setups.rule: the token's first-ever insider unlock (under 25%), and open interest on the exchange we trade fell 10% or more from day -15 to day -8

skipIf: price up 30% or more from the open 30 days before the unlock to the open on entry day (day -7)
no USDT perpetual on Binance, and none on OKX, Bitget, Gate or Hyperliquid whose price confirms it is the same token
the unlock is not confirmed (date, size or recipients unconfirmed by the project or two independent sources)

trade.entry: short at the 00:00 UTC open, 7 days before the unlock

passMark: After 30 live trades: average above +0.25R. Until then, treat it as a test.
approvedBy: Coach K in chat, 25 Nov 2026: "always check where tokens are traded and if they have perps on other exchanges ... so we dont have to skip if we do not need to"
changes: Same setups, entry, stop, target, exit and size as v3. The only change is where the short is placed.

A token with no Binance USDT perpetual is no longer skipped if OKX, Bitget, Gate, Hyperliquid, KuCoin or MEXC lists one AND its price confirms it is the same token (within 15% of CoinGecko's price for the token, or within 5% of Binance or another exchange; more than 10x off = a different asset, e.g. a stock perp with the same ticker). Ticker matches alone are not trusted: OKX's 'ADI' is a ~$300 asset, ADI Chain is ~$7.
Where more than one other exchange qualifies, use the one with the most dollar volume over the last 7 days.

The open-interest rule uses that exchange's open interest. Only Binance, OKX and Gate publish free open-interest history, so a first insider unlock that trades only on Bitget, Hyperliquid, KuCoin or MEXC is skipped.

A 'can't short it' skip is only made after Binance, Bybit (via CoinGecko), OKX, Bitget, Gate, Hyperliquid, KuCoin and MEXC have all been checked; if any can't be reached, the token stays on watch and is rechecked. Bybit is a listing check only (no candles), so a Bybit-only token is skipped.
evidenceOffBinance: Thin: the history test found 4 qualifying trades on Bybit/Gate-only tokens (+5.5R in total, research/exchange_test.json). Smaller exchanges can slip more than the 0.5% assumed.
